title: P2-1c closed: Cost panel + Gherkin caption refactored, 13 lifecycle frames swapped
summary: Refactored the promoted Cost panel (added optional seventh footnote row with show-footnote BOOLEAN + footnote-text TEXT props) and the Gherkin caption (rebuilt from 2-column to 8-slot per-row-frame model with 16 caption-level props: 8 visibility booleans + 8 prose text, plus per-row Keyword variant). Bootstrapped full token foundation (Colour 16 variables, Spacing 9, Radius 4) with two new tokens — Spacing/xxs (6) and Radius/sm-plus (6) — as part of the bootstrap since no variable collections existed in the file. All 13 lifecycle stage frames swapped from local copies to bound component instances with verbatim prose; five frames carry active footnote rows (Stage 03, 06, 07b, 08b, 08c); Console chrome band corner radius bound to Radius/sm-plus. Every primitive on every lifecycle frame is now a bound, documented component instance.
